verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Supabase auto-generates type-safe REST/GraphQL APIs and publishes per-language reference corpora (js, dart, swift, kotlin, python, csharp) via llms.txt, plus generated TypeScript types (database.types.ts), indicating official SDKs exist across multiple ecosystems that an AI-native builder could target. However the pack lacks a dedicated SDK documentation page, install instructions, or hands-on examples of an agent actually building against these SDKs (most 'AI-native' evidence instead centers on MCP/agent tooling rather than SDK usage itself). Missing for 10: explicit official SDK docs/reference pages, hands-on or independent evidence of an AI agent successfully using a Supabase SDK to build an app.
